items.title: Marlon Jackson Reveals Stage 4 Prostate Cancer Diagnosis
items.excerpt: Jackson 5 member Marlon Jackson says he has lived with prostate cancer for four years and has undergone surgery and radiation.

items.title: NBA Vet Amar’e Stoudemire Trades His Jersey For A Police Uniform
items.excerpt: NBA star Amar’e Stoudemire took an oath of public service as a police officer after a massive career in pro hoops.

items.title: Wale Spends A Day As Dunbar Principal While Students Study His Lyrics
items.excerpt: Wale served as principal for a day at Washington's Dunbar High School, where students broke down his lyrics during Gifted Week.

items.title: Leaf Ward Plans A Return To The Studio After Federal Custody
items.excerpt: Leaf Ward talks fatherhood and recording again after federal custody, with Meek Mill and G Herbo calling in to welcome him.

items.title: Coco Jones Joins Queen Latifah In New Ice Age Movie
items.excerpt: Coco Jones will voice Peaches, the daughter of Queen Latifah's Ellie, in Disney's upcoming Ice Age: Boiling Point.

items.title: GTA VI Pulls In $3.79 Billion On Day One
items.excerpt: GTA VI opens with an estimated $3.79 billion in worldwide retail sales after selling 32.5 million copies before launch.

items.title: Childish Gambino’s “This Is America” Hits 1 Billion YouTube Views
items.excerpt: Childish Gambino's "This Is America" is his first video to reach 1 billion YouTube views, eight years after its debut.

items.title: GloRilla’s Basically Said Megan Thee Stallion Was Hating On Her Winning
items.excerpt: GloRilla’s comments about one-sided support revives questions about her relationship with Megan Thee Stallion.

items.title: Philip Bailey Brings Comfort Cases Into Holiday Drive For Foster Youth
items.excerpt: Philip Bailey's Music Is Unity adds Comfort Cases to a holiday drive that supports foster youth and runs through December 4.

items.title: Sir Mix-A-Lot Gets A Lasting Spot In Seattle Music Exhibition
items.excerpt: Sir Mix-A-Lot gets a lasting section at Seattle's Museum of Pop Culture, with Stas THEE Boss playing the opening day.
